mentions.name: PuzzleLair
mentions.description: A website for playing puzzle games without ads, featuring a growing collection (currently 9 games) including favorites like Killer Sudoku and Calcudoku, with a clean mobile-friendly UI, keyboard shortcuts for desktop, leaderboards, and achievements.
mentions.problem: Existing puzzle game sites force players to sit through ads before playing.
mentions.audience: Puzzle game players who want a variety of games without ads, on mobile or desktop
mentions.source_excerpt: Got tired of sitting through ads to play puzzle games (my favorites are Killer Sudoku and Calcudoku), so I built my own site to play them on. I'm trying to get a huge collection of a variety of games all with a clean, mobile-friendly UI, keyboard shortcuts for desktop, leaderboards, and achievements.
